summary: Mobile web preview and public backend smoke-tested. Customer auth gate, registration, empty catalog, five-tab navigation, admin login, and API contracts were exercised.
action_items: Add an Admin Studio delete control for dispatched/cancelled orders; backend DELETE exists but the mobile admin order list exposes no delete action.
Wire Home 'Shop now', Home 'See all', and 'View all' actions; they currently have empty onPress/no navigation behavior.
Add stable testID attributes to interactive controls for reliable mobile regression automation.
Align frontend environment naming with the requested EXPO_BACKEND_URL or document the existing EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL convention; the test runner initially had no EXPO_BACKEND_URL value.
critical_code_review_comments: src/api.ts constructs its base URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, while the review environment contract names EXPO_BACKEND_URL; it works only because the project currently defines the public variant.
Home category filtering mutates the displayed products state and does not provide a reset path back to the full catalog, which will be problematic once products are added.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (core flows pass; admin Studio navigation not deterministically reverified in isolated browser context)

seed_data_creation: Created one uniquely prefixed TEST_ customer account through the public registration API; no catalog/order seed data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Initial catalog is intentionally empty. Public preview tested at phone viewport 375x667. Customer auth gate, registration, five tabs, Products empty state/filters, and backend root/categories/products/admin login/protected orders passed. Expo log contains a non-blocking React Native DevTools electron sandbox warning; Metro still bundles successfully.
rca_of_issue: Admin delete gap: AdminStudio renders Dispatch/Mark delivered and WhatsApp share actions only; although api.deleteOrder exists and backend restricts deletion to dispatched/cancelled statuses, no UI path calls it. CTA gap: Home SectionTitle and hero buttons are rendered with onPress={() => {}} or omitted handlers, so taps produce no navigation.
